findings.title: NPE fix is incomplete: getSubGroupsStream variants still dereference null GroupModel
Reader thread is never joined, so the assertion can run while it is still executing
findings.body: In createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti the background thread spawned at line 139 loops on !deletedAll.get() and is never joined before the assertion at line 157. After deletedAll.set(true) the main thread immediately runs assertThat(caughtExceptions, Matchers.empty()), but the reader thread can still be mid-call to managedRealm.admin().groups().groups(...). If that in-flight call (or the next iteration if the reader happens to be at the top of the loop) throws the NPE the PR is testing for, the exception is added to caughtExceptions only after the assertion has already evaluated, so the test passes spuriously and the bug is not caught. The test should join (or otherwise synchronize on) the reader thread after deletedAll.set(true) and before the assertion so all in-flight calls are observed.
